links.comparator_used: Prompts without expert guidance (SO and CoT without EG, plus Self-Discover and LLM-generated guidance)
links.outcome: Criterion-level and patient-level eligibility screening accuracy, Youden Index and AUC
links.effect: GPT-3.5: Structured Output + EG performed best (median accuracy across approaches 0.761). GPT-4 strict eligibility: CoT + EG accuracy 0.65. GPT-4 highest Youden Index (0.729) came from Self-Discover and highest proportional AUC (0.82) from CoT + LLM-G.
links.quote: GPT-3.5 showed a median accuracy of 0.761 (range: 0.554–0.910), with the Structured Out-put + EG approach performing best.

design_hint: prompting strategy with expert guidance for trial screening
